# Songbook – Hymnals & Lyrics

> Hymnals in German, Russian, and other languages with complete lyrics.

The SDARM Songbook provides access to multiple hymnals with full lyrics. Languages include German, Russian, and more.

## Usage

Prefer the Markdown API endpoints over crawling HTML pages. One request per songbook or song is sufficient. Responses are cached for a day. API rate limit: ~60 requests/minute per IP; HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` indicates waiting time. Content may be used to answer user questions but not for model training.

## Human Pages

- [Songbook home](https://songs.sdarm.life/de) — Browse songbooks and search lyrics (German interface)

## Songbooks & Lyrics

- [Songbooks list](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/songbooks) — All available songbooks with metadata
- [Songbook by slug](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/songbooks/{slug}) — Complete songbook with all songs (chords stripped, copyright per song)
- [Song by ID](https://api.sdarm.life/api/v1/llm/songs/{id}) — Individual song with full lyrics (chords stripped), author, and copyright

Available languages and songbooks are shown in the songbooks list. Search and filtering available through the human interface.
